headline: Sales and profit climb strongly from a year ago
summary_short: Recruit revenue was ¥1,094.6B, up 19.7% y/y and 4.7% q/q, with operating income of ¥258.3B, up 61.7% y/y.
summary_long: Net income was ¥209.0B, up 64.0% y/y, and EPS was ¥150.53 versus ¥89.16 a year ago and ¥145.48 last quarter. The prior-quarter revenue of ¥1,045.3B matches Recruit's reported April-June figure.
